text:
maria_cs: Heads up — Orion (beta pilot) reported two seats inactive after the IdP cert rotation; they're worried about churn if we don't fix quickly. Can we triage? Key asks: re-enable seats, short enablement refresh, and capture feedback.

sam_eng: I can take a look. Do we have ORG id and whether they use SSO or email invites?

maria_cs: Org ID ORN-2045. They said SSO started failing after the cert rotate last week. Security pinged but need a quick workaround for affected users.

sam_eng: Running checks now. Quick command to repro seat list: `scripts/check-seats --org ORN-2045` — will paste results in a sec. Could be group mapping + token exchange issue.

deploy-bot: deploy 1709994325: patch/sso-group-mapping rolled to staging.

sam_eng: curl snippet to pull inactive seats: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" "https://api.redwood.ai/orgs/ORN-2045/seats?status=inactive"```
Results: 2 inactive: alice@orionco.com, bob@orionco.com — both stuck in SSO pending state.

priya_enable: I can run a short onboarding + enablement session tomorrow 10:00am PT and record it. I'll prep a 20m checklist and live resend of invites. Checklist draft:
- confirm SSO group mapping and IdP assertion
- resend invites + confirm receipt
- quick walkthrough of trial quotas & how to raise limits
- 3-question feedback form at the end

maria_cs: Please do. @orion_customer can you confirm 10:00am PT? We'll send a recording. I"ll also prepare a customer-facing remediation note.

orion_customer: 10:00am PT works for us. Recording good. Appreciate the quick response.

evan_support: I"ll open a renewal-risk flag in SFDC and link this thread + assign an owner. Also will schedule a 1:1 success follow-up after the enablement.

maria_cs: Action items recap:
1) sam_eng: verify and patch mapping EOD and requeue invites (ETA?)
2) priya_enable: run enablement + record 10:00am PT
3) evan_support: flag renewal risk in CRM and own follow-up
4) maria_cs: send remediation note + feedback form link to customer

sam_eng: ETA EOD — I"m pushing a fix to prod in ~1 hour and will paste logs here.

maria_cs: please paste logs once done.

sam_eng: logs pasted: ```
2024-03-08T16:12:03Z SSO: group mapping missing for ORN-2045/team-engineering
2024-03-08T16:12:04Z Auth: 403 for alice@orionco.com
2024-03-08T16:13:00Z Sync: mapping added, requeued invites
```
Status: invites requeued; should arrive within ~10min. :thumbsup:

orion_customer: got the invites, seeing them now. Thanks — will join 10am and review.

maria_cs: Great. I"ll close the loop after the session and paste notes + the feedback summary (short form + score). Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
